block_node.block_desc:
Trigger the downstream function-call subsystem from an interrupt service routine.
The block output triggers the downstream connected function-call subsystem when the selected interrupt occurs.
Select the interrupt service routine with the 'Interrupt group' and the 'Interrupt name' parameters. The 'Interrupt number' displays the corresponding ARM Cortex-M interrupt vector table entry. Use the 'Simulink task priority' parameter to set the priority of the downstream function-call subsystem. The default model base sample rate priority is set to 40 with a lower priority value indicating a higher priority task. These settings can be adjusted in the 'Solver' pane of the 'Configuration Parameters'. The Simulink task priority of the selected interrupt is relative to the model base rate priority. Check 'Disable interrupt pre-emption' to block all other interrupts while executing the selected interrupt service routine. Check 'Add simulation input port' to enable the 'SimIRQ' block input. In simulation, the block triggers the downstream function-call subsystem if 'SimIRQ' is TRUE. 'SimIRQ' is ignored in the generated code.

Configures GPIO outputs for the specified pins.
In regular mode a value of True at the input of the block will pull the GPIO pin high. A values of False will ground the pin.
In toggle mode, a value of True at the input of the block will switch the actual output level of the GPIO pin. A value of False has no effect on the output level of the GPIO pin.
Configures GPIO inputs for the specified pins with qualification type settings.

Send serial data to the Universal Asynchronous Receiver Transmitter(UART) port.
Use the additional package header and additional package terminator parameters to package the message with known starting and ending series of ASCII characters.

Receive Data From the Universal Asynchronous Receiver Transmitter(UART) port.
Use the additional package header and additional package terminator parameters to extract the message from a package with known starting and ending series of ASCII characters. Use data length to specify the number of output signals of the selected data type to receive. Use the blocking mode parameter to wait until the serial port has enough data to receive.

Send UDP packets to another UDP host
Set the Remote IP address and Remote IP port parameters to the IP address and port number of the receiving UDP host, respectively.
Set the Local IP Port parameter to the desired local port to be used.

Receives UDP packets from another UDP host specified by the Remote IP address.
The block outputs the values received as an [Nx1] array.
The sending UDP host must send UDP packets from the Remote IP Address to the Local IP port specified.

Send TCP packets to another TCP host on TCP/IP network.
Set the Local IP Port to be used as TCP Server port.
In Client connection mode, set the Server IP address and Server IP port parameters to the IP address and port number of the receiving TCP/IP host, respectively.

Receive TCP packets from another TCP host on TCP/IP network.
Set the Local IP port parameter to the port number used by the sending TCP host.
In Client connection mode, set the Server IP address and Server IP port parameters to the IP address and port number of the receiving TCP/IP host, respectively.

Send serial data to CAN Bus.
In "Raw data" mode, the block accepts a 1-D array of type uint8. In "CAN msg" mode, the block accepts input as Simulink bus signal from CAN-FD Pack block

Read data From the CAN Bus.
In "Unpack" mode, the block outputs the different fields of unpacked CAN Msg.
In "Packed" mode, the block outputs Simulink bus signal. To extract data from Simulink bus signal, connect it to CAN-FD Unpack block.

The block outputs specific bits of MCAN_IR register or the entire MCAN_IR register. The values are cleared after reading the specific bits or entire MCAN_IR register.
Select the "MCAN interrupt register output" parameter to output the entire MCAN interrupt register.
If "MCAN interrupt register output" parameter is not selected then the block outputs specific bits from MCAN_IR register based on the selection from "Transmit sources", "Receive sources" and "General sources".

Performs an inter-processor data transmit from CM to one C28x core.
Select a channel number matching the channel on the corresponding IPC Receive block.
The block accepts scalar or vector data with a data container not exceeding 32 bits.

Performs an inter-processor data receive from the C28x core to the CM.
Select a channel number matching the channel on the corresponding IPC Transmit block.
